candidates.name: python-dateutil (rrule)
candidates.evaluation_notes: RFC 5545 recurrence is error-prone to reimplement. Pure Python, one small dependency (six). GitHub license metadata is NOASSERTION, but the LICENSE file itself was fetched via /repos/dateutil/dateutil/license: it is the standard Apache-2.0 text plus the pre-2017 BSD-3-Clause dual-license notice. Both are permissive and compatible. Integrated ONLY behind app.planning.engine.expand_recurrence so upstream code stays untouched.

candidates.name: FastAPI
candidates.evaluation_notes: Mature, MIT, typed validation via Pydantic, no build step for the UI. Chosen as API layer.

candidates.name: SQLAlchemy + Alembic
candidates.evaluation_notes: Versioned migrations and ORM-only queries (no string SQL) reduce injection risk. SQLite locally / PostgreSQL on VPS.
candidates.test_result: pass: alembic upgrade head + repository integration tests

candidates.name: FullCalendar
candidates.evaluation_notes: Excellent calendar UX, but our planner currently has one day view and no build pipeline. Adds ~200KB JS for a need we do not have yet. Re-evaluate when weekly/monthly drag-and-drop is required.

candidates.name: Chart.js
candidates.evaluation_notes: Charts must be based on real data. With only a few logged days, hand-drawn inline SVG from real records is lighter. Re-evaluate at >=30 data points.

candidates.name: LangGraph
candidates.evaluation_notes: Powerful, but replaces our deterministic orchestrator with a graph runtime and a large dependency tree. At this phase a single model plus scoped tools is cheaper and more testable. More agents do not imply better answers. Revisit only if stateful branching workflows become a measured need.

candidates.name: crewAI
candidates.evaluation_notes: Requests broad tool access including code execution. Violates the rule that a skill must not gain shell/network rights by being installed.

candidates.name: mem0
candidates.evaluation_notes: Would move personal memory into an external vector store/service. Privacy and vendor lock-in costs exceed benefit while the dataset is small. Our scoped SQL memory keeps data local.

candidates.name: Model Context Protocol servers
candidates.evaluation_notes: Repository-wide license metadata is NOASSERTION (per-server licenses differ). Broad filesystem/exec permissions. Requires per-server license and supply-chain review before ANY adoption.

candidates.name: Anthropic Agent Skills
candidates.evaluation_notes: GitHub API reports NO license field for the repository. Skill files are untrusted data and may contain prompt injection. Must be treated as reference only until license is clarified; never auto-executed.

candidates.name: Microsoft AutoGen
candidates.evaluation_notes: Repository license metadata resolves to CC-BY-4.0 (a content license, ambiguous for code reuse). Combined with code-exec permissions, integration is blocked pending legal clarification.

candidates.name: APScheduler
candidates.evaluation_notes: Will be needed for morning/evening review reminders. Not integrated yet: no scheduled job exists in this phase, and an idle scheduler adds a process with no value.
